pluginval.name: Fetch pluginval ${{ env.PLUGINVAL_VERSION }}
pluginval.run:
set -euo pipefail
curl -L --fail --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 \
  -o pluginval.zip \
  "https://github.com/Tracktion/pluginval/releases/download/v${PLUGINVAL_VERSION}/pluginval_Linux.zip"
unzip -q pluginval.zip -d pluginval
test -x pluginval/pluginval
./pluginval/pluginval --version | tee pluginval-version.txt

pluginval.name: Verify diagnostic exit propagation
pluginval.run:
set -euo pipefail
python3 -m py_compile scripts/run-pluginval-with-core.py
for expected in 0 7 139; do
  set +e
  python3 scripts/run-pluginval-with-core.py \
    --core-log "$PWD/pluginval-core-fixture.log" \
    --executable /bin/sh -- /bin/sh -c "exit $expected"
  actual=$?
  set -e
  if [ "$actual" -ne "$expected" ]; then
    echo "::error::Diagnostic helper changed exit $expected to $actual"
    exit 1
  fi
done
# A diagnostic log open failure must not override the child result.
set +e
python3 scripts/run-pluginval-with-core.py \
  --core-log /dev/null/unwritable.log \
  --executable /bin/sh -- /bin/sh -c 'exit 7'
actual=$?
set -e
if [ "$actual" -ne 7 ]; then
  echo "::error::Diagnostic log failure changed child exit to $actual"
  exit 1
fi
# Do not synthesize a crash when the kernel routes cores externally:
# Linux pipe collectors ignore RLIMIT_CORE, including a zero limit.
pattern="$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/core_pattern)"
if [[ "$pattern" != \|* ]]; then
  set +e
  python3 scripts/run-pluginval-with-core.py \
    --core-log "$PWD/pluginval-core-fixture.log" \
    --executable /bin/sh -- /bin/sh -c 'ulimit -c 0; kill -SEGV "$$"'
  actual=$?
  set -e
  if [ "$actual" -ne 139 ]; then
    echo "::error::Diagnostic helper changed SIGSEGV status to $actual"
    exit 1
  fi
else
  echo "Synthetic signal fixture unavailable with kernel pipe collector; exit139 fixture remains required."
fi
# A normally exited inferior has no live thread/register context.
# Exercise the same guard as the failure-only diagnostic below.
gdb -nx -nh --batch --return-child-result \
  -iex "set auto-load off" \
  -iex "set debuginfod enabled off" \
  -iex "set print frame-arguments none" \
  -ex "run" \
  -ex "python if gdb.selected_inferior().pid: gdb.execute('thread apply all bt 40'); gdb.execute('info sharedlibrary')" \
  --args /bin/true > pluginval-gdb-normal-exit.log 2>&1
echo "Diagnostic exit propagation and normal-inferior guard checked."

pluginval.name: Select failed validator log for diagnostics
Diagnose validator failure with gdb
pluginval.run:
set +e
set -o pipefail
mkdir -p pluginval-diagnostic-reports
seed_args=()
display_args=(xvfb-run -a -s "-screen 0 1920x1200x24")
gui_args=()
if [ "$DIAGNOSTIC_LOG" = "pluginval-headless.log" ]; then
  display_args=()
  gui_args=(--skip-gui-tests)
fi
echo "Diagnostic original log: $DIAGNOSTIC_LOG"
seed="$(python3 scripts/pluginval-diagnostic-seed.py "$DIAGNOSTIC_LOG")"
if [ -n "$seed" ]; then
  seed_args=(--random-seed "$seed")
  echo "Diagnostic replay seed: $seed"
else
  echo "Diagnostic seed differs or is unmatched; nonreproduction cannot isolate debugger timing."
fi
timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=10s 240s \
  "${display_args[@]}" \
  gdb -nx -nh --batch --return-child-result \
  -iex "set auto-load off" \
  -iex "set debuginfod enabled off" \
  -iex "set print frame-arguments none" \
  -ex "set pagination off" \
  -ex "set print thread-events off" \
  -ex "run" \
  -ex "python if gdb.selected_inferior().pid: gdb.execute('thread apply all bt 40'); gdb.execute('info sharedlibrary')" \
  --args ./pluginval/pluginval \
  "${seed_args[@]}" "${gui_args[@]}" \
  --strictness-level 10 \
  --validate-in-process \
  --timeout-ms 120000 \
  --output-dir pluginval-diagnostic-reports \
  --output-filename cs80-gui-gdb \
  "$PWD/vst3/CS-80 Reference.vst3" 2>&1 | tee pluginval-gui-gdb.log
statuses=("${PIPESTATUS[@]}")
echo "Diagnostic process exit: ${statuses[0]}; log capture exit: ${statuses[1]}"
echo "Original validation remains failed. This rerun is diagnostic evidence only."
if [ "${statuses[1]}" -ne 0 ]; then exit "${statuses[1]}"; fi
exit "${statuses[0]}"

pluginval.name: Build and test fault-thread diagnostic shim
pluginval.run:
set -euo pipefail
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends gcc libunwind-dev
mkdir -p pluginval-trace-tools
cc -std=c11 -O2 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -fPIC -shared -Wl,-z,now \
  scripts/pluginval-fault-trace.c -lunwind \
  -o pluginval-trace-tools/fault-trace.so
cc -std=c11 -O0 -g -Wall -Wextra -Werror -rdynamic -pthread \
  scripts/pluginval-fault-fixture.c \
  -o pluginval-trace-tools/fault-fixture
python3 scripts/test-pluginval-fault-trace.py \
  pluginval-trace-tools/fault-trace.so pluginval-trace-tools/fault-fixture

pluginval.name: Diagnose validator with fault-thread trace
pluginval.run:
set +e
set -o pipefail
mkdir -p pluginval-trace-reports
seed_args=()
display_args=(xvfb-run -a -s "-screen 0 1920x1200x24")
gui_args=()
if [ "$DIAGNOSTIC_LOG" = "pluginval-headless.log" ]; then
  display_args=()
  gui_args=(--skip-gui-tests)
fi
echo "Diagnostic original log: $DIAGNOSTIC_LOG"
seed="$(python3 scripts/pluginval-diagnostic-seed.py "$DIAGNOSTIC_LOG")"
if [ -n "$seed" ]; then
  seed_args=(--random-seed "$seed")
  echo "Diagnostic replay seed: $seed"
else
  echo "Diagnostic seed differs or is unmatched; nonreproduction cannot isolate debugger timing."
fi
# Preload the validator (and possible descendants), not timeout/Xvfb/env.
# One rerun, same binary and plugin. It cannot replace the failed gate.
timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=10s 240s \
  "${display_args[@]}" \
  env LD_PRELOAD="$PWD/pluginval-trace-tools/fault-trace.so" \
  ./pluginval/pluginval "${seed_args[@]}" "${gui_args[@]}" \
  --strictness-level 10 \
  --validate-in-process \
  --timeout-ms 120000 \
  --output-dir "$PWD/pluginval-trace-reports" \
  --output-filename cs80-gui-trace \
  "$PWD/vst3/CS-80 Reference.vst3" \
  198>pluginval-fault-trace.log 2>&1 | tee pluginval-gui-trace.log
statuses=("${PIPESTATUS[@]}")
cat pluginval-fault-trace.log
echo "Trace diagnostic process exit: ${statuses[0]}; log capture exit: ${statuses[1]}"
echo "Original validation remains failed; diagnostic nonreproduction is inconclusive."
if [ "${statuses[1]}" -ne 0 ]; then exit "${statuses[1]}"; fi
exit "${statuses[0]}"

pluginval.name: Report pluginval failure
pluginval.run:
for log in pluginval-headless.log pluginval-gui.log pluginval-gui-seed-regression.log; do
  if [ -f "$log" ]; then
    echo "::error title=pluginval $(basename "$log")::$(tail -n 20 "$log" | tr '\n' ' ')"
  fi
done
